schedule.stop: SIGINT or SIGTERM sets an idempotent request flag. The admission critical section blocks stop signals and either admits no row or durably seals provider_input.txt, spawn_message.txt, and attempt.json before emitting one spawn request. Once admitted, the trusted root must perform the one spawn and passively drain that same subagent through first terminal delivery or typed failure; it never interrupts, follows up, retries, or replaces. The controller then seals the row and stopped terminal accounting before exit.

semantic_pipeline.fail_stop: A complete FINAL_RETURNED result with deterministic subject mismatch is durably completed as FAIL and makes all later same-slot rows ineligible; no later same-slot attempt is admitted.
semantic_pipeline.finalizer: After a PASS completion, create every newly eligible same-slot artifact as canonical expected_artifact payload plus one LF, verify its declared payload and storage identities, then reopen it.
semantic_pipeline.invalid_stop: Any transport, dependency, mutation, custody, identity, or evidence INVALID aborts all slots.
semantic_pipeline.operational_rule: Operational rule: source_bindings.authority classifies the source document or excerpt; it does not by itself establish a downstream boundary. predecessor_outputs are controlling. Return false when they resolve the apparent discrepancy and leave no boundary. Return true when a conflict remains unresolved, a required resolution is missing, or predecessor_outputs establish distinct authorities, scopes, sequences, lineages, or evidence roles that downstream synthesis must keep separate.
